defaults_atb2025._about: NREL ATB 2025 (atb_year 2025, Moderate, R&D case, CRP 30), national averages in 2023 $; New England multiplier unverifiable. Values for 2026. These are PRESETS: rules/finance.js applies them only when the user picks a named preset, and every field then carries the preset's name and source.

pv_tracking.note: New England is likely classes 7–8 (verify with NSRDB GHI). Class 7 and 8 CF are the 2024 base-year values (R3 §4); class 5 is 2026.

atb_finance.src: NREL ATB 2025, ATBe.parquet v1.0.0 rows Tax Rate / WACC Nominal; CRP 30 (R3 C4, §3.1, §4)
atb_finance.note: Tax rate is blended federal + state; New England state rates unverified (R3 open question 9). ATB WACC is a contracted-asset benchmark, low for a merchant ISO-NE site.
